run_subprocess_command: run a subprocess command and capture stdout and stderr output with exit code
set_env_var: set or unset an environment variable to a given value for test configuration
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a test binary and verify it exists on disk
get_exit_status: extract the exit status code from an os.system result on Unix or Windows
run_gtest_main: run the unit test suite after parsing and stripping Google Test flags from argv
